about: Frontier Defence wave kinds (W10, Defence 6.7): a wave group may carry `kind: "<id>"`; every unit of that group spawns as that kind (sim/content/wave-kinds.js). hp and speed multiply the unit's own. shieldwall: single-target hits x single, splash (Mortar, Shrapnel, Cluster) x blast; Barrage and burning ground are untouched. crawler: slows never hold (noSlow). surgeon: heals allies within radius by heal every `every` seconds. brood: on death, `count` broodlings (the group faction's vanguard slot) walk on, each with childHp of a vanguard's health, childSpeed and childBounty of its bounty. tint is the [r, g, b] factor on the unit's model (instanceColor, no draw), ring the hex colour of its ground mark, endless the share of an Endless wave budget one unit of the kind spends (1 = a plain unit). Used only by the levels and Endless waves that name a kind: no other match reads this file.
